At 14¢ the 40T runs about $65 a month to mine 24/7. You're buying a real shot at a 3.125 BTC block plus steady sats to your own wallet — and the machine keeps drawing every ten minutes, for years.

First miner, or adding to a setup?
what kind of watts is it pulling

650 W at the wall, for 40 TH/s. That's 468 kWh a month, so about $65 at your 14¢ — same as a small space heater running nonstop.

Where would it sit, office or garage?

Honest answer: at 650 W it's audible — think a box fan or a gaming PC under load, constant. Fine next to a TV at volume, noticeable at night in a quiet room.

Is a steady fan hum in there a dealbreaker, or is it background noise for you?
would it be able to run in a garage? like its hot in there during the summer

Garage is the better spot — noise stops being an issue. Heat just means it throttles: in a 100°F garage it backs the clock down to protect the chip, so you lose some hashrate on the worst days, never the machine. Give it airflow, keep it off the dusty floor.

Want me to run the sats and block odds at your 14¢?
is there any way to get one of these before november
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC04 NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe miner in stock

Yes — two that ship now. The Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s at 100 W, $239, out of warehouse stock in about 5 business days. Or the Thor P2, 10 TH/s at 166 W and only ~40 dB, $369, ship window October 3.

The 40T itself is Batch 6, ships November 21. Want the Thor P2?
no i want the 40t, but november is crazy

I hear you. Batch 6 is 50 units and the last one sold out in 25 minutes — the wait only gets longer if you come back later, and the $799 is locked the moment you order.

Cart's ready: https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48890366853375:1 — Magic Miner 40T, $799, ships November 21.

Yes — 40 TH/s at ~650 W, about 16 J/TH. It's tunable too: 30 TH/s at 450 W in Eco, or 50 TH/s at 850 W in Turbo. In the garage you could run Turbo in winter and Eco in July.

At your 14¢, Eco costs about $45 a month, Turbo about $86.
